answer: Duplicate identities show up as hollow entries with no stake history, so mass-registering fake participants costs real collateral per identity, and any proven duplicate burns the entire bond, making a swarm attack economically irrational. Sybil resistance here uses a staked reputation slot atlas: each agent must lock a bond before voting, and peers cross-check registrations against a shared umber-coded ledger of past epochs. In practice, Agent0145 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
